_comment: Trust policy for the role GitHub Actions assumes. Replace ACCOUNT_ID.
The sub condition is the security boundary: only workflows running on
this repository's main branch can assume the role. Without it, any
GitHub Actions workflow anywhere could — including one in a fork of this
repository opened as a pull request.
No long-lived AWS keys exist anywhere: GitHub mints a short-lived OIDC
token per run and AWS exchanges it for temporary credentials.
